sources.title: proofbird (Proofbird) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Proofbird — a writing assistant for Windows that checks spelling and grammar as you type, in the apps you already use. The grammar models run on your own computer: your text doesn't leave the machine for a grammar check.
